art.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons
art.story: A girl turns to look over her shoulder, lips parted, as if we had just called her name. Nobody knows who she was. Vermeer did not paint a portrait but a "tronie", a study of a face and an exotic costume: a blue and yellow turban, a plain white collar, and a pearl far too large to be real, probably glass, made with two quick touches of white paint. Vermeer worked slowly in Delft and left only about 35 paintings.
